mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate persistently below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and financing costs, directly supporting S&P 500 valuations and generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 12-month moving averages indicates broad-based economic strength that boosts corporate earnings and reduces equity risk premiums, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO both above 12-month MA) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a moderate inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annualized 1.5-3.0%), a monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.2% signals inflationary pressures that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% and annualized CPI is 1.5-3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, directly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average signals contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings expectations and increases equity risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) sustains accommodative monetary conditions that support long-term equity valuations through low discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,000.0 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for housing and related sectors, boosting economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0.
